name: Nam Illam
subtitle: Pantry, shopping & home
promotional_text: Your pantry, shopping list, receipts and plans in one calm place. Works offline, needs no account, and learns the names on your receipts.
description:
A little order. More room for living.

Nam Illam ("our home" in Tamil) brings everyday household life into one calm place on iPhone and iPad: what is in your kitchen, what to buy, what you spent and what is coming up.

YOUR DAY, IN FOCUS
Today shows the tasks, shopping and pantry items that need attention, with a quick look inside your fridge.

SHOPPING THAT REMEMBERS
Keep one shared list with stores, quantities and who is buying. Buy again suggests the things your household usually rebuys by now, based on how often you have bought them. Nothing is added until you tap Add.

A PANTRY THAT SORTS ITSELF
Add what you have and Nam Illam files it into rice and grains, produce, dairy, spices and more, with a clear icon for each item. Track amounts, low stock and the expiry dates you enter.

RECEIPTS, MADE READABLE
Scan a receipt and review the store, date, items and total before anything is saved. Short printed labels such as "RSTD PIST" are turned into readable names, and the app shows the bill's own wording beside each suggestion. Fix a name or a store once and Nam Illam remembers it for next time, on your phone.

SPENDING AT A GLANCE
Record purchases as expenses and see monthly totals alongside your household records.

PLAN WHAT TO COOK
Explore meal ideas from what is already in your pantry and add missing ingredients to shopping.

YOUR HOME, ORGANIZED
Keep rooms, belongings, warranties and home care together. Start by hand; room-layout tools are optional.

SHARE WHEN YOU CHOOSE
Share your home with family through iCloud. Send chosen appointments to Apple Calendar and connect a selected Apple Reminders list if you want to.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Core household records work offline, with no Nam Illam account. Receipt reading, name suggestions and pantry sorting run on your device. On-device intelligence depends on your device, iOS version and Apple Intelligence settings; manual entry always works.

Please review scanned receipt details before saving and check ingredient labels and allergens yourself. Expiry dates are records you enter, not a food-safety assessment. Meal and AI suggestions can be incomplete or incorrect. iCloud sharing needs compatible Apple accounts and available iCloud storage.
whats_new:
A warmer, smarter Nam Illam.
• New look: warm ivory and amber in light mode, mocha and champagne in dark mode, with stronger contrast when you turn on Increase Contrast.
• Today: clearer Tasks and Shopping cards that show what needs doing at a glance.
• Buy again: suggestions for what your household usually rebuys by now.
• Your pantry sorts itself, with a clear icon for every item.
• Receipts: short printed labels become readable names, the bill's wording shows beside each suggestion, and store names are read more reliably.
• Nam Illam now remembers the store and item names you fix, so the next receipt from the same store reads right.
• Fixes and performance improvements.
